info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Payments Payments Disputes-v3-spec
info.description: The Payments Dispute Management API provides a streamlined approach to accessing information regarding payment disputes. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of disputes associated with payments, facilitating effective monitoring and resolution. Typical consumers of this API include financial institutions, payment processors, and e-commerce platforms that require timely access to dispute data. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance their applications with features for dispute tracking and management.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to fetch the details of a specific payment dispute, including its status and relevant transaction information.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the payment dispute details.
